title: TITLE intelligence layer
description: Domain shape for layers.LAYER_ID, owned by the SKILL_NAME skill. Copy this file to schema/layers/<id>.schema.json, fill in the domain fields below, then register the layer in schema/layers/registry.json (status 'active', point owner_skill + schema at it). The envelope (competitor.schema.json) does not change — that is the contract that keeps every existing profile valid when a new layer is added.

meta.description: Common layer header (layer_id, collected_by, collected_at, layer_version, status) — validated by the envelope schema.

$comment: Add your domain-specific properties alongside `meta`. Prefer typed enums for anything that appears in a rendered table, keep list-of-competitors keys identical across profiles so tables align, and register every load-bearing fact as a claim in the envelope's `claims` array (with layer set to this layer's id).
